verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks. Each confirmed release blocker sets verdict BLOCKED and grade 0. Supported points, coverage and the evidence interval retain their uncapped values. Unmeasured safety evidence prevents PASS.
source: Gameplay recordings, spectator captures, redaction checks and release records for published claims.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.

releaseBlockers.reason: A measured spectator information policy violation blocks release.
A measured spectator feed or stream delay violation blocks release.
A player name exposed in the streamer capture blocks release.
Sensitive information exposed in the streamer capture blocks release.
A tested spectator feed that fails to open as intended blocks release.

no-spectator-mode.reason: The game has no spectator or live viewing mode; its 20 points are shared over the other lines and the spectator feed blockers do not apply. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

no-share-links.reason: The game offers no share or watch links. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

no-streamer-mode.reason: The game has no streamer mode and never shows player names, chat or account details on screen, so there is nothing to redact; the redaction blockers do not apply. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.
